انتقشنا (form VIII)
# اِنْتَقَشْنَا (intaqašnā) /in.ta.qaʃ.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِنْتَقَشَ (intaqaša)
# اُنْتُقِشْنَا (untuqišnā) /un.tu.qiʃ.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِنْتَقَشَ (intaqaša)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
